title: CitySpec
description: What street level to build. Everything but id and theme has a default, so the smallest useful spec is { id, theme }.

id.description: Instance id of the street level.

label.description: Name shown on the map overlay.

blocks.description: How many city blocks to build on. Overrides sizeHint, so "four blocks" is exactly four.

sizeHint.description: Shorthand for `blocks`: a 2x2, 3x3 or 4x4 lattice. Default medium.

lots.description: How many buildings to place across the whole city. Default: two to four per block, drawn from the seed.

accessibleRatio.description: Share of buildings with a front door. Default 1, or 0 when `buildings` names any: name the places you want and everything else is scenery. A sealed building has no door, nothing built behind it, and the exit gate never waits on it.

buildings.description: Pin individual premises; everything else is generated around them.

floorsPerLot.description: Floor count per lot, in order. Short lists repeat their last value; omitted means every lot is a single floor.

npcs.description: How many NPCs to place in each instance. Default 2; 0 leaves the level empty. Read by the toolkit, not by the street layout itself.

wet.description: How wet the streets are, 0 dry (the default) to 1 soaked. Wet asphalt is darker and throws long reflections of the lamps down it. It never rains.

exit.description: Place the locked exit gate. Default true. False builds a street with no way to win.

pin.title: BuildingPin
pin.description: One building an author chose, by where it stands. The block is split into enough premises to hold the slot.

block.description: Which city block, in lattice order (row by row from the south-west).

label.description: Name shown on the map overlay and over the door.

asset.description: Id of a `building` in asset-registry: a whole building in one GLB stands here at its own size, and the block is cut big enough to hold it. Without one the building is a mass this layer sizes and dresses itself.

floors.description: How many floors you can walk into.

storeys.description: How tall it stands. Most of a tall building is scenery over the street.

accessible.description: false seals it: a mass with no door.

quest.description: Put the run's objective in this building. Implies a door.
